Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clarion POC performance snapshot + brief endorsement request

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for running the pilot with Redwood. We wrapped up data collection this morning and I wanted to share a short summary of the outcomes and a quick ask. The attached workbook has the full numbers and screenshots; below is the executive snapshot we use for short customer quotes.

Quick results (3-week POC, production-like traffic profile):
- 99th-percentile inference latency reduced from 820ms -> 95ms (~88% improvement) using our continuous batching and KV cache.
- Average throughput increased 2.3x on the same instance class (NVIDIA A100) after model & kernel tuning.
- Per-token compute cost decreased ~40% due to batching + quantization profile.
- Pilot processed ~1.2M tokens across 120k requests; error rate (malformed outputs) <= 0.6%.

Why this matters: Clarion saw faster response times for agent assist workflows while lowering unit cost — the combination we expect is what our customers use as the basis for production rollouts.

Two quick asks:
1) Would Clarion be willing to provide a 1–2 sentence quote (we can draft) about the performance/cost impact we just shared?
2) If OK, can we schedule a 15-minute call next week to record a short testimonial and confirm logo/attribution language?

Proposed times: Thu 12/17 10:00–10:15am PT or Fri 12/18 2:30–2:45pm PT. Happy to work around your schedule.

Attachments: clarion-poc-metrics.xlsx (detailed metrics), dashboard-screenshots.png

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

—
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
